name: Macapype NHP anatomical processing pipeline
purpose: Process nonhuman primate (NHP) brain MRI data in BIDS format, including data preparation, brain extraction, and brain segmentation, with optional template-based processing and derivatives output.
species_scope: macaque, marmoset, baboon, chimpanzee (as supported by -species option)

inputs.statement: Input data must be in BIDS format, with T1w and T2w images expected.
inputs.quote: All the data have to be in BIDS format to run properly

inputs.statement: T1 weighted images are expected with the _T1w BIDS extension.
inputs.quote: _T1w (BIDS) extension is expected for T1 weighted images

inputs.statement: T2 weighted images are expected with the _T2w BIDS extension.
inputs.quote: _T2w (BIDS) extension is expected for T2 weighted images

inputs.statement: All files with the same extension (T1w or T2w) will be aligned to the first one and averaged.
inputs.quote: All files with the same extension (T1w or T2w) will be aligned to the first one and averaged

conditions.statement: The -data parameter must point to an existing BIDS format directory.
conditions.quote: -data : path to your data dataset (existing BIDS format directory)

conditions.statement: The -out parameter must point to an existing output path.
conditions.quote: -out : path to the output results (an existing path)

conditions.statement: The -soft parameter must be either SPM or ANTS, with SPM requiring a specific version of macapype/skullTo3d not available by default.
conditions.quote: -soft : can be one of these : SPM or ANTS ( NB: SPM requires a specific version of macapype/skullTo3d, not available by default)

conditions.statement: Either -params or -species must be provided; -params is mandatory if -species is omitted, and vice versa.
conditions.quote: -params : (mandatory if -species is omitted) a json file specifiying the global parameters of the analysis.

steps.statement: Optionally use -deriv to create a derivatives directory with important files named following BIDS derivatives convention.
steps.quote: -deriv : creates a derivatives directory, with all important files, properly named following BIDS derivatives convertion.

steps.statement: Optionally use -padback to export most important files in native (original) space.
steps.quote: -padback : exports most important files in native (original) space

steps.statement: Optionally specify a subset of the BIDS dataset using -sub, -ses, -acq, -rec, and control parallelism with -nprocs.
steps.quote: -sub (-subjects), -ses (-sessions), -acq (-acquisions), -rec (-reconstructions) allows to specifiy a subset of the BIDS dataset respectively to a range of subjects, session, acquision types and reconstruction types.

checks.statement: The -test option can be used to check if the full pipeline is coherent, generating only graph.dot and graph.png.
checks.quote: _test : (at the end) to check if the full pipeline is coherent (will only generate the graph.dot and graph.png)

checks.statement: The -prep option performs only data preparation, without brain extraction and segmentation.
checks.quote: _prep (at the end) will perform data preparation (no brain extraction and segmentation)

checks.statement: The -noseg option performs data preparation and brain extraction, but no segmentation.
checks.quote: _noseg (at the end) will perform data preparation and brain extraction (no segmentation)

exceptions.statement: The _4animal option uses bet4animal (FSL) for brain extraction, for faster computation; by default atlas_brex is used.
exceptions.quote: _4animal : will use bet4animal (FSL) for brain extraction, for faster computation (by default atlas_brex is used)

exceptions.statement: The marmoT2 species option can be used for segmenting from the T2w image; by default, T1w is used for marmo.
exceptions.quote: NB : marmoT2 can be used for segmenting from the T2w image (by default, T1w is used for marmo)

exceptions.statement: Some templates are available in downgraded versions (e.g., baboon1_0p6, macaque_0p5) showing significant decrease in processing time with low reduction in quality, but not all combinations are available.
exceptions.quote: NB : some templates are available in downgraded versions: baboon1_0p6, baboon2_0p6 baboon3_0p6 and macaque_0p5 and show significant decrease in processing time with low redection in quality. However, not all combinations are available

outputs.statement: The pipeline can create a derivatives directory with all important files, properly named following BIDS derivatives convention.
outputs.quote: -deriv : creates a derivatives directory, with all important files, properly named following BIDS derivatives convertion.

outputs.statement: The pipeline can export most important files in native (original) space using -padback.
outputs.quote: -padback : exports most important files in native (original) space

outputs.statement: The -test option generates graph.dot and graph.png files to check pipeline coherence.
outputs.quote: _test : (at the end) to check if the full pipeline is coherent (will only generate the graph.dot and graph.png)

parameters.statement: The -indiv or -indiv_params parameter allows a JSON file to overwrite default parameters for specific subjects/sessions.
parameters.quote: -indiv or -indiv_params : a json file overwriting the default parameters (both macapype default and parameters specified in -params json file) for specific subjects/sessions.

parameters.statement: The -params parameter specifies a JSON file with global parameters of the analysis, mandatory if -species is omitted.
parameters.quote: -params : (mandatory if -species is omitted) a json file specifiying the global parameters of the analysis.

parameters.statement: The -species parameter specifies the NHP species corresponding to the image, e.g., macaque, marmo, baboon, chimp; mandatory if -params is omitted.
parameters.quote: -species : (mandatory if -params is omitted) followed the NHP species corresponding to the image, e.g. {macaque | marmo | baboon | chimp}

claim.statement: Run the main script segment_pnh.py as a Python script, or use the segment_pnh command if installed via pypi or container.
claim.quote: The main file is located in workflows and is called segment_pnh.py and should be called like a python script: $ python workflows/segment_pnh.py

claim.statement: Specify the input data directory, output directory, and software choice (SPM or ANTS) as mandatory command line parameters.
claim.quote: -data : path to your data dataset (existing BIDS format directory) -out : path to the output results (an existing path) -soft : can be one of these : SPM or ANTS

claim.statement: Provide either a -params JSON file with global parameters or a -species option specifying the NHP species (e.g., macaque, marmo, baboon, chimp).
claim.quote: -params : (mandatory if -species is omitted) a json file specifiying the global parameters of the analysis. See Parameters for more details -species : (mandatory if -params is omitted) followed the NHP species corresponding to the image, e.g. {macaque | marmo | baboon | chimp}

claim.statement: Optionally specify the datatype for brain segmentation using -dt, which can be 'T1' or 'T1 T2'; default is T1 if omitted.
claim.quote: -dt : specifies the datatype available to perform brain segmentation (can be “T1”, or “T1 T2”) Note : default is T1 if the attribute is omitted

claim.statement: Optionally use -mask to specify a precomputed binary mask file, skipping brain extraction; only works with -soft ANTS and the mask must be in the same space as the data.
claim.quote: -mask allows to specify a precomputed binary mask file (skipping brain extraction). ... Warning: the mask should be in the same space as the data. And only works with -soft ANTS so far

claim.statement: The _quick option uses hd-bet (Deep Learning) for brain extraction, for faster computation; hd-bet requires a specific version of macapype/skullTo3d not available by default.
claim.quote: _quick : will use hd-bet (Deep Learning) for brain extraction, for faster computation (by default atlas_brex is used) **NB: ** hd-bet requires a specific version of macapype/skullTo3d, not available by default

claim.statement: The _robustreg option should be used if coregistration to template in preparation is not performed correctly, providing a more robust registration in two steps.
claim.quote: This option should be used if the coregistration to template in preparation is not performed correctly: _robustreg (at the end) to have a more robust registration (in two steps)

claim.statement: Baboon templates baboon0, baboon1, baboon2, baboon3 can be used for template Baba21 and matching ages.
claim.quote: NB : baboon0, baboon1, baboon2 baboon3 can be used for template Baba21 and matching ages

claim.statement: The -nprocs parameter specifies the number of processes allocated by the parallel engine, typically equal to the number of subjects*session, default is 4 if unspecified.
claim.quote: -nprocs : an integer, to specifiy the number of processes that should be allocated by the parralel engine of macapype typically equals to the number of subjects*session (i.e. iterables). ... default = 4 if unspecified ; if is put to 1, then the sequential processing is used
